facts.condition: Upon independent derivation, researchers know that separately concavifying the two directional UV scores commutes with channel products. A receiver-swap involution then makes the balanced and averaged scalar scores agree for the half-skew instance and each of its finite tensor powers.

assumptions: Channel input and output alphabets are finite, and product uses are memoryless.
No extension is assumed to a jointly coupled auxiliary-variable optimization, the full UV region, or the exact sum-capacity.
The half-skew specialization may rely on the previously accepted scalar support bound declared by the accepted claim.
